description: In front of you on a green mat is a small white square tray with a tall rectangular post on it, plus a separate white block off to the right. The left hand stays planted on the front edge of the tray to steady it while the right hand reaches down and left to pick up the loose block, lifts it, and moves it over the tray to press and fit it into a recessed spot beside the tall post, then releases while keeping the tray stable with the left hand.
